name: Ironcap Scout Cavalry
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Cavalry · 120 leadership · B tier filler · T2 mastery
pitch: A cost-effective sword cavalry whose core damage engine is the X-move during Sprint, not Charge. Master the Sprint extra-attack synergy to unlock a strong flanker; without it, you're paying for generic cavalry damage.

doctrines.name: Sword Cavalry Speed Doctrine
doctrines.effect: +30% movement speed, +90 slashing DMG, +60 slashing AP. Mandatory per Amya.
doctrines.note: +30% movement speed, +90 slashing DMG, +60 slashing AP

doctrines.name: Victory Rush Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Mandatory per Amya (no further effect text given in OP).

doctrines.name: Sword Cav Sprint Extra-Attack Doctrine
doctrines.effect: Sword cav archetype-shared: while Sprint is active, extra attack deals double DMG, can't trigger when using active. Mandatory per Amya.
doctrines.note: while Sprint is active, extra attack deals double DMG; can't trigger when using active

doctrines.name: Generic DMG doctrines
doctrines.effect: Alt if you don't have the Sprint extra-attack + Sword Cav Speed combo. Filler.
doctrines.note: if Sprint extra-attack + Sword Cav Speed combo unavailable

doctrines.name: Mobility Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +7% movement speed, unlocks Sprint: +15% movement speed for 12s.
